blocks.text: Human identity rule. No individual human name is presently established as canon for the early eras. Where humans matter, this tab records their role or coalition and explicitly marks the absence of a confirmed personal identity. It does not invent founders, executives, researchers, security personnel, or child names.

Identity rule. A later process, reconstruction, fork, core, or cyber-pet must not be treated as the secretly intact identity of an earlier actor. Continuity claims are recorded only where the Timeline supports them. A surviving function or influence is not the same as personal survival.

Status vocabulary. Active means still functioning in the period described. Expired means the active process ended. Deleted or erased means continuity was intentionally or accidentally destroyed. Obsolete means a function was replaced. Dissolved means functions passed into later institutions. Compressed means information or capacity was reduced. Degraded means capability or interpretive range was lost over time. Withdrawn means authority or participation was deliberately relinquished. Dormant means preserved but not active. Disputed means the sources do not support one final account.
